# expression value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:expressionValue`](gmeow-expressionValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/expressionValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gender`](../../slices/gender.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The [`gmeow:GenderExpressionStyle`](../classes/gmeow-GenderExpressionStyle.md) value a gender-expression facet asserts (functional per facet). A predefined individual or a fresh one with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label); the single path to the value.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:GenderExpression`](../classes/gmeow-GenderExpression.md) -> [`gmeow:GenderExpressionStyle`](../classes/gmeow-GenderExpressionStyle.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:expressionValue`](gmeow-expressionValue.md) from [`gmeow:GenderExpression`](../classes/gmeow-GenderExpression.md) to [`gmeow:GenderExpressionStyle`](../classes/gmeow-GenderExpressionStyle.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

    gmeow:facetSubject    ex:robin ;

    gmeow:selfAsserted    true .

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single [`gmeow:GenderExpressionStyle`](../classes/gmeow-GenderExpressionStyle.md) value a gender-expression facet asserts; mint a fresh value individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) when no seeded style fits.

### Avoid when

- Avoid placing more than one value on a facet (it is functional per facet) and avoid a flat datatype shortcut; this object path is deliberately the only one.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:GenderExpressionStyle`](../classes/gmeow-GenderExpressionStyle.md) individual per [`gmeow:GenderExpression`](../classes/gmeow-GenderExpression.md) facet; for varying presentations create several facets, each with its own [`gmeow:expressionValue`](gmeow-expressionValue.md).
